# ops_variable_set (Resource)

A variable set: variables (ops_variable_set_variable) shared by many workspaces, such as a subscription's credentials. It applies globally, or where it's attached (ops_variable_set_project, ops_variable_set_workspace). Repository-linked workspaces get only sets attached to them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The subscription's credentials, for every workspace of the project.
resource "ops_variable_set" "azure_prd" {
  name = "azure-prd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Its name; changing it replaces the set.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `global` (Boolean) Applies to every workspace that isn't linked to a repository.
- `priority` (Boolean) Its variables win over the workspace's own and other sets': for values an admin enforces.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# by name or id
terraform import ops_variable_set.azure_prd azure-prd
```
